summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stripe integration for FocusNote Pro subscription. All major features working correctly with $3/month pricing.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 404 for newly created checkout sessions
minor_bugs.impact: Payment status polling may fail immediately after checkout creation

working_endpoints: /api/stripe/portal - Correctly returns 400 for users without subscription
/api/subscriptions/checkout - Legacy endpoint working for backward compatibility
/api/profile - Returns user data with plan information

passed_tests: Pricing page displays Free ($0) and Pro ($3/month) plans correctly
Free plan card shows: Up to 10 tasks, Brain dump (3 days), Basic AI parsing, Current plan button
Pro plan card shows: Most popular badge, lavender border, Unlimited tasks, Focus Mode, Full brain dump history
Upgrade now button triggers Stripe Checkout successfully
Authenticated users see 'Back to dashboard' link in header
Focus Mode upgrade modal shows $3/month price correctly
Profile page shows 'View pricing' for free users
Customer Portal endpoint returns proper error for users without subscription
